name: Niello
author: E. T. Carter
description: A niello panel read in negative: a black alloy ground stippled edge-to-edge with tiny punch marks that scintillate in palette-tinted sparks, while a burnished strapwork interlace stays perfectly still and unlit — an ornament made of absence, disclosed by where the shimmer is not.

params.label: Twinkle rate
params.effect: Frequency of the punch-mark glints; 0 calms the ground to a dim constant stipple (the figure stays legible), 3 boils it into restless glitter.

params.label: Punch spacing
params.effect: Spacing of the stipple punches in CSS pixels — fine coal-dust grain at the minimum, coarse hobnail texture at the maximum.

params.label: Figure
params.effect: How completely the burnished strapwork suppresses the shimmer; 0 lets faint twinkle leak across the figure until it nearly dissolves into the ground, 1 cuts a perfectly still black silhouette.

params.label: Pattern scale
params.effect: Tightness of the interlace weave; low spreads a few grand straps across the panel, high packs a dense fine knotwork.

params.label: Pattern angle
params.effect: Rotates the whole strapwork figure to any angle while the stippled ground stays put.

params.label: Randomize
params.effect: Re-lays the interlace into a fresh configuration; scrub it to shuffle the knotwork pattern through endless variations.

params.label: Twinkle speed
params.effect: How fast each punch-mark glint flickers, independent of how many twinkle; 0 freezes the sparkle mid-shimmer, high sets it racing.

params.label: Strap width
params.effect: Thickness of the whole figure - both the interlace ribbons and the medallion rings; low draws fine lacy knotwork lines, high swells them into bold burnished bands.

params.label: Weave style
params.effect: Morphs the figure pattern: 0 is a pure diagonal basket weave, 0.5 the full crossed interlace, 1 a square orthogonal lattice.

params.label: Medallion
params.effect: Strength of the concentric rings at the centre; 0 leaves a pure weave with no focal rosette, high sets a bold medallion at the heart of the panel.

params.label: Medallions
params.effect: How many medallions tile across the panel; low gives one grand central rosette, high scatters a dense field of small medallions (combine with Randomize to vary each one).

params.label: Light angle
params.effect: Bearing of the burnished sheen raking across the strapwork; rotate it to move the lit faces of the figure.

params.label: Light motion
params.effect: Speed the sheen sweeps along the figure; 0 holds a fixed still gradient, higher rakes the lamplight slowly across the burnished metal.
